attempts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a 4-column by 2-row sprite sheet of EIGHT CONSECUTIVE WALKING POSES of the SAME lumberjack in the supplied reference. Reference image role: exact character identity, painted style, clothing, elevated rear camera. Every pose faces directly NORTH, away from the viewer. Never turn sideways. Axe remains in anatomical RIGHT hand, on screen RIGHT; screen-left hand is empty. No log. Same orange cap, green shirt, rolled cream sleeves, brown trousers and boots, belt, back-view silhouette. Pure solid WHITE background, NO checkerboard, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no ground shadow.
Priority is real eight-phase motion with OPPOSITE LEGS, not eight duplicates. Rear view walking away: the advancing foot moves UPWARD on the image; the trailing foot moves DOWNWARD and shows its sole. Row-major poses 1-8: 1 LEFT boot far UP and RIGHT boot far DOWN; 2 LEFT planted, RIGHT heel lifts; 3 RIGHT knee bends and passes beside planted LEFT leg, feet nearly together; 4 RIGHT boot swings UP as LEFT starts trailing; 5 RIGHT boot far UP and LEFT boot far DOWN (visibly reverse pose 1); 6 RIGHT planted, LEFT heel lifts; 7 LEFT knee bends and passes beside planted RIGHT leg, feet nearly together; 8 LEFT boot swings UP as RIGHT starts trailing. Opposite arm swing; right-hand axe follows hand but remains firmly held. Subtle vertical body bob. Eight distinct sequential phases, suitable for looping 8 to 1. Fit every complete figure in its equally sized cell, equal scale and centered pelvis, clean generous margins.
attempts.outcome: Actual opposite-leg halves and passing poses. Rejected because frames 5-7 have incorrect/missing axe hand.

attempts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. In the BOTTOM ROW ONLY, figures 1, 2, and 3 currently wrongly have an axe in their SCREEN LEFT hands or no axe. Remove each of those screen-left axes and make each SCREEN LEFT hand empty with natural curled fingers. Put the same short-handled axe into the SCREEN RIGHT hand of each of those three figures, hanging blade down with handle firmly gripped, matching the fourth figure in the bottom row and original reference. No other changes. CRITICAL preserve the exact current EIGHT leg poses, positions of every boot and knee, body scale, rear viewing direction, painting, cap, sleeves, pure WHITE background, and 4-column 2-row layout. Do NOT mirror any character or any legs. Do not add or remove frames. No checkerboard. Eight axes total, always screen-right.
attempts.outcome: Axe corrected to anatomical right/screen right in every frame; leg poses preserved. Selected for diagnostic preview.
